1) Yes, the Persian letters are correctly joined in proper cursive (e.g., "ثروت‌مرکب", "سرمایه‌گذاری" all connect correctly).

2) The numerals are Persian/Eastern Arabic (۰، ۵، ۸، ۱۴۲۵، ۲۶٫۷٪).

3) Yes, the layout is right-to-left: content aligned to the right, RTL reading order, bullet lists and labels mirrored correctly, with the Latin URL on the left (LTR) side.

4) No tofu boxes or question marks; the text is clean. Minor overlapping/crowding appears near "بازار" where chart labels collide, but no garbled glyphs.

5) One complete line: "در ۱۴۰۲ خرج‌داد از ۱۰٬۰۰۰ عروء می‌کند" — more clearly: "در ۱۴۰۲ خرج‌داد از ۱۰٬۰۰۰ عبور می‌کند." (In 1402, spending exceeds 10,000.)
